newsitem.title: KENYA: More refugees in Zaire flee from camps.
newsitem.headline: More refugees in Zaire flee from camps.

text.p: About 200,000 Rwandan Hutu refugees have fled a camp in eastern Zaire and are caught in battles between rebels and the Zairean army, an aid worker said on Friday quoting refugee reports.
"Katale (camp) is empty. The refugees say that they are on the run and caught in the crossfire," Michele Quintaglie of the World Food Programe (WFP) told Reuters by telephone from Goma.
Quintaglie said Katale camp, about 45 km (28 miles) north of Goma, had held 210,000 refugees.
She said that radio reports on Friday from refugees had given news of the flight from the camp.
The refugees are Rwandan Hutus and the rebels are Tutsis.
Quintaglie said she did not know where the refugees were going, but she guessed it might be towards the southwest.
